name: Equinix ME4 Melbourne (ex-Metronode Melbourne 2) Stage 2 expansion

address.note: ME4 campus address per Baxtel (source 4) and Inflect/datacentermap listings; Equinix ME4 page gives only 'Melbourne, VIC 3026' (source 5). Stage 2 is on the existing Melbourne 2 site; exact building footprint within the site not published.

lat.note: Geocoded 2026-09-27 from '2 Davis Court, Derrimut VIC 3026' with the ArcGIS World Geocoder (PointAddress, score 100). Point for the site address, not the Stage 2 building specifically.

builder.note: design and construct; Icon's third Metronode project at Derrimut (source 1)

developer.note: built by Metronode for an unnamed international hyperscale customer (source 3); Metronode acquired by Equinix (announced Dec 2017, source 6) and the site renamed ME4

mw_it.note: Icon: '7.6MW installed', 'ultimate designed capacity of 18MW' (whether the 18 MW is for Stage 2 or the whole site is unclear). Press coverage calls it a new '8MW hyper-scale facility' (source 3, snippet). The original 2012 Melbourne2 building supported up to 12 MW (source 2) and is out of scope.

cost_aud_m.note: Icon project value '$62 Million' (construction contract value). Metronode's wider A$150m 2017 programme covered Derrimut, Silverwater and Unanderra (source 7).

authority.note: presumably Brimbank City Council; permit not found

construction_start.note: Metronode (snippet only): 'In February 2017, preparatory works began on the Derrimut, Melbourne site to mark the start of construction of a new 8MW hyper-scale facility'. Icon gives duration '12 Months'; Metronode claims the build took nine months.

construction_end.note: Icon: completion date September 2017; Metronode (source 3, snippet) also says completion September 2017

open_questions: whether Stage 2 is a separate new building or an extension of the 2012 Melbourne2 building (Icon scope includes new offices, loading dock, car park and site works, suggesting a new building)
18 MW 'ultimate designed capacity': Stage 2 alone or whole site
planning permit (Brimbank City Council) not found
